title: Governance case
description: Governance case (GovernanceCase): one promotion of a functionary to the commission of its tenant; if there is no vacant seat, one holder from the list L leaves, proposed by code by accuracy (GOV-43) or chosen by a person on the promotion card (GOV-12). Only the core writes it; only the governance loop opens it for the head of the queue, there is no P2 open operation (GOV-6). The list L does not change after opening (GOV-12). A case has no free text, and no bot sees it (GOV-29). Flags only from spec/model/governance-flags.yaml (GOV-19).

tenant.description: Tenant of the commission; the case lives only in it (GOV-16).

hold.description: Pause by people: a hold on the governance scope (GOV-14).

proposal.description: The proposal that is the trigger.

mode.description: removal: someone from L leaves; vacancy: a vacant seat.

items.description: Seat id: commission:<seat number from the tenant charter>; the farm manager seat is never in L.

seats.description: The figures of every seat of L over 180 days, built by code (GOV-12); from v0.3 with accuracy (COM-17).

seat.description: Seat id: commission:<seat number from the tenant charter>; the farm manager seat is never in L.

confirmed.description: Recommendations with the trial outcome better, and vetoes people upheld.

refuted.description: Recommendations with the outcome worse or a confirmed attribution, and vetoes lifted by people with the trial outcome not worse and no attributions.

accuracy.description: From v0.3: accuracy of the holder in its lens, or insufficient (COM-17).

scored_forecasts.description: From v0.3: scored forecasts of the holder (COM-16).

proposed.description: From v0.3: the leaver code proposes by accuracy, or null when code proposes nobody and a person chooses (GOV-43).

anyOf.description: Seat id: commission:<seat number from the tenant charter>; the farm manager seat is never in L.

snapshot.description: Unchangeable list at opening with the figures of its seats (GOV-12).

outcome.description: Outcome: {leaver: seat} with the seat a person chose or confirmed, or {vacancy: seat}.

confirmation.description: People's decision: who, when, the decision with the chosen seat, and a reason code from governance-decline-reasons.yaml for Reject; only a human principal.

allOf.description: A removal case carries the list L with the figures of its seats (GOV-12).
